Question: Why are smaller branch cuts preferred, and when is formative structural pruning preferable?
Subject: subject
Smaller branch cuts are preferred because they allow woody plants to compartmentalize wounds more effectively, limiting pathogen intrusion and decay. Formative structural pruning is preferable when pruning young plants, as it is easier to manage wounds and prevent future issues compared to pruning large branches in mature plants. [1]
